name: The Fate of Zephras
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless.. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Ayessa's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet and on the timeline of elemental gods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 3,295 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Earthen Ring
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.

quests.name: Exploring the Horde
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions.
